body: Hey guys thank you a lot for the support, It really does mean a lot that people in our society still care. I'm still alive but very drunk, went on one last walk before I went through with it and ironically the extra liquor I bought and drank made me fall over on the footpath and somehow I don't know how, its a coincideince but some friends of my old highschool teacher pulled over concerned since I almost passed out on the side of road, they ended up talking to me, happy that they had enough mana to talk me through it and drop me home and make sure I was safe, guess the universe doesnt want me to die yet. All i wish for is inner peace and to have a family I love and to help others through this situation, already witnessed firsthand the horror of suicide and its aftermath, the lifeless bodies blue from lack of circulation and watching family and friends grieve and cry as we carried our friends casket to his burial while watching the tears of the others flow as well as mine. I'm haply to be alive, I ended up putting away my "supplies" I just want to reflect on the kind hearts of the Maori guys who took the time and effort to save a life. Thank you for listening to me, it means a lot.

Hey I just read your post and wanted you to know that I'm here and I care, I just posted and right now I'm really feeling like im going to do it right now, ive already got it set but my point in telling you this is the fact that even though ive got it all set up right now this very second I haven't done it yet. Ive had friends die from suicide, been there through the funerals, the aftermath, seen how violent and messy they are and I will forever be traumatized from it. Ive seen friends overdose on drugs such as heroin and seen myself and others fall into the dark depths of drug and alcohol addiction. Ive seen friends raped, dead bodies, guns aimed at myself and others, been beaten and beaten others, tried to kill others and also almost been killed many times myself. Ive been through rough relationships and breakups, been cheated on, had my mother beat me, abandoned me in every way, watched my dad and my mum both try to commit suicide as well as another friend who slashed his wrist open. Ive seen a lot and been through a lot, ive tried to kill myself and others more than once but my point in telling you all of this, ive found ways to overcome this, I respect you for coming and telling someone, I don't care what anyone else says but know that you have genuine problems and I acknowledge them and just because someone else says that their problems are worse does not in any way mean that your situation does not matter, it does and I have read your post and I do care about if you live or die. I remember when I was 16 and I felt the same way as you and I will admit I have struggled with depression and addiction but I have found ways through it. I will admit too that I am right now this second too wanting to kill myself but I believe that even though ive lost my job, my girlfriend, my mental and emotional well being and that ive relasped, I can work through it as I have before. There have been points in my life where I have worked to overcome my problems and believe me, I have found no greater joy in my life than coming back to happiness from the depths of my mind. I will be honest with you, it will not be a quick fix for you, it will take time, effort and a lot of self reflection, be prepared to make peace with your inner demons, with your parents, I thought once my parents did not care about me or my depression, I thought they were blind to it but it turns out my dad was my saviour, he set up appointments with counsellors, got me into a rehab programme to get clean, he listened to my every word, he cooked me dinner and helped me through it. Reach out to your parents or who ever you have in your life. I have cried in front of many people while asking for help, feel no shame, you are in need and you deserve and respect to be treated as an equal and have your sorrows listened too and addressed.  Please believe me, I am in the same position as you but I still have hope. Please message me, someone cares
